text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: ...!? Wh-What a burst of speed...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye!! A new star is born!! She 
bursts through in a flash with tremendous 
acceleration!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Racing really is the best, 
isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In contrast to Almond Eye's refreshed look 
after giving her all in the race she had 
longed for, the entire venue was in an 
absolute uproar.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey... that girl is unreal...! What kind 
of legs are those...!? She's insanely 
strong...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, I'm breaking out in a cold 
sweat. It's beyond hot... I'm freezin' 
now!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"...Just maybe, that girl could become an 
extraordinary Umamusume on par with that 
Grand Lady—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye-san, first of all, 
congratulations. That was a spectacular 
victory...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Even in the press box, the buzz didn't 
settle down for a while after Almond Eye's 
magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"With things turning out like this, the 
question on everyone's mind is your path 
going forward...!"
choice_data_list: Almond Eye will be aiming for the Oka Sho

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
In that case, does that mean our target is 
naturally... the Triple Tiara!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, if we keep going like this, I 
want to win the Oaks and the Shuka Sho 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still—my goal is to win! My aim is 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
O... Ooh...? Is she a girl who's just... 
purely focused on winning?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
At any rate... I thought Lucky Lilac would 
dominate the Tiara route this year, but 
another unbelievable girl has appeared...!
choice_data_list:
(The world is finally starting to see how 
strong she really is.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel expectations swelling. And among 
them, of course, are my own. What will she 
achieve from here on out—

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
—"However—my goal is to win! My aim is 
victory!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Honestly, what an interesting kid.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having decorated her Classic year debut 
with a brilliant victory, Almond Eye 
rested for a few days to recover from the 
race's fatigue—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm in top shape! Even right after the 
race, I wasn't nearly as exhausted as 
after my debut...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It feels like my body and mind are 
perfectly in sync now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she continues post-race care, it 
seems she won't fall into the state where 
her "spirit gets ahead of her body" 
anymore.
choice_data_list:
Well then, let's start preparing for the 
Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for this! In other 
words—we're figuring out how to beat Lala, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I put together a compilation of Lala's 
race footage! Want to study it together 
while we watch?"
choice_data_list:
In that case, I'll go look for the mock 
race footage too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I'm counting on you! I'll go 
get some light exercise in the meantime.
choice_data_list: ...You just can't sit still, can you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm almost at the level of the 
girl I've been aiming for!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew... huff, phew... huff.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Workin' hard today too, eh, Ai-san?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on the Shinzan Kinen. That 
was a mighty impressive run.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! It makes me happy to be 
acknowledged by you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Next time, right before your eyes, I'll 
show you an even more amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I'm lookin' forward to it. However—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If I cross the finish line before you even 
see it, don't hold it against me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, fufu...! Fufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... Sparks are flying... —The 'Oka 
Sho' is gonna be fierce...
